verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no open-licensed source for Okta's core identity platform (SSO, SCIM, event hooks). The only open-source evidence covers peripheral artifacts: an 'Open Source MCP Server' with no license named, and a community remark about Okta's open-source packages. Those are adjacent ecosystem tools, not the product's own source, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
